scope: Summarize read-only contact measurements; no new physical inference or calibration.
interpretation: Physical traces reproduce all three baselines exactly. Records actual solved contact values; no new force/torque/friction values or production change. Raw force polarity is not assigned to a body. Cone utilization uses installed MuJoCo contact dimension4 and friction ordering tangent1,tangent2,spin; contacts below0.05N are omitted only from this descriptive ratio, never from actual safety/retention decisions. Normal sums are not a vertical support wrench or a minimum grip-force certificate. Full wrench feasibility and physical calibration remain open.
